articles.title: Joel and Ethan Coen reuniting for their first film together in nearly a decade
articles.summary: The Oscar-winning siblings co-wrote “Jack of Spades,” marking their first project together since 2018.
articles.body:
Joel and Ethan Coen co-wrote Jack of Spades .

The film marks the Coen brothers' first collaboration since 2018's The Ballad of Buster Scruggs .

Jack of Spades hits theaters in fall 2027.

The Coen brothers are back in business together.

Joel and Ethan Coen are collaborating on the upcoming film Jack of Spades , Netflix officially announced in a press release on Monday.

The Oscar-winning siblings wrote the screenplay for the film together, along with New Zealand-born novelist Eleanor Catton ( Emma ) and Irish playwright Conor McPherson ( The Eclipse ).

The film marks the duo's first collaboration since 2018's The Ballad of Buster Scruggs . Since going their separate ways, Joel directed 2021's Shakespeare adaptation The Tragedy of Macbeth . Ethan, meanwhile, helmed 2024's Drive-Away Dolls and 2025's Honey, Don't — both co-written by his wife Tricia Cooke and starring Margaret Qualley. Ethan also directed the 2022 documentary Jerry Lee Lewis: Trouble in Mind , and wrote several one-act plays collected in the anthologies A Play Is a Poem and Let's Love .

Joel is directing Jack of Spades alone, marking his second solo directorial effort and his first time individually helming a project co-written by his brother. (Joel was the only credited director on the duo's first 10 movies due to DGA regulations, but he and Ethan directed all of their films together until the 2020s.)

Based on Frances Frederica Montrésor's 1901 novel The Alien: A Story of Middle Age , Jack of Spades stars Patsy Ferran, Josh O'Connor, Damian Lewis, and Lesley Manville. Joel, his wife Frances McDormand, Robert Graf, Indian Paintbrush's Steven Rales, as well as Blueprint Pictures' Graham Broadbent and Pete Czernin are producing the film, while Donald MacKinnon is executive producing.

The film is shot by cinematographer Bruno Delbonnel, who shot the brothers' Inside Llewyn Davis and The Ballad of Buster Scruggs , as well as Joel's The Tragedy of Macbeth . Frequent collaborator Carter Burwell, who has worked on almost every Coen film, will score the project.

A logline describes the film as "A sinister gothic mystery filled with intrigue and betrayal set in the atmospheric Scottish Highlands."

The brothers reunited last month for a career retrospective event at the Lumière Film Festival in Lyon, France, where they teased the possibility of more collaborations.

"There are a couple of other stories that we've thought about that would take place in Minneapolis, which is where we come from," Joel said at the event (per Variety ). "So we'll see if they haven't sort of germinated to the point where we would go, you know, that's what we're going to do next, or we're even going to definitely do."

Ethan also noted that the duo has worked on several screenplays that never made it to production. "We've written a lot of scripts that we've never made," he said. "One of the Minneapolis stories we were talking about had a main part intended for an actor who has since died. So we're thinking, well, we're not sure that's going to work. That's a consequence of aging."

The Coens won their first Oscars for Best Original Screenplay for 1996's Fargo . They also won awards for Best Picture, Best Director, and Best Adapted Screenplay for 2007's No Country for Old Men .

Get your daily dose of entertainment news, celebrity updates, and what to watch with our EW Dispatch newsletter .

Netflix will release Jack of Spades in theaters in fall 2027.

articles.title: Funk do 'petista disfarçado' tem base popularizada na União Soviética | G1
articles.standfirst: Melodia que acompanha versos contra a esquerda em 2026 surgiu como ode ao povo russo na década de 1860 e, após revolução comunista de 1917, se tornou popular na URSS e entrou na trilha do game Tetris.
articles.summary: A batida que embalou eventos de apoiadores de Flávio Bolsonaro percorreu diferentes países e décadas antes de ganhar uma versão no para o eleitorado da direita brasileira.
articles.body:
O funk do "quem ficar parado é petista disfarçado" , que embalou atos de apoiadores de Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) na eleição de 2026, usa uma melodia com mais de 160 anos de história. É o tema do videogame Tetris, que nasceu de uma canção popular russa, foi gravado por um coro do Exército Soviético e chegou ao funk carioca há mais de duas décadas.

Oficialmente chamada "Solinho do Fora PT" , a música viralizou depois que Lucas Pavanato e Eduarda Campopiano (PL), eleitos deputado federal e deputada estadual por São Paulo, comemoraram a vitória dançando ao som dela. Depois, passou a tocar nos "bloquinhos do 22" e em comícios do então candidato à Presidência.

A melodia que acompanha versos contra a esquerda surgiu com uma letra que exalta o povo russo na década de 1860 e, após a revolução comunista de 1917, se tornou popular na URSS e foi cantada pelo coro do exército soviético.

Década de 1860 : surge na Rússia a partir do poema "Korobeiniki", de Nikolai Nekrasov, e vira canção popular

Década de 1980 : entra no repertório do coro do Exército Soviético, que grava a canção em show em Londres

1989 : vira o tema do Tetris na versão para Game Boy, com arranjo do japonês Hirokazu Tanaka

Início dos anos 2000 : a versão do Tetris chega ao funk carioca em montagens, e aparece em "Jonathan da Nova Geração", da Furacão 2000

2026 : a mesma melodia embala o funk do "petista disfarçado"

A melodia tem raiz antes mesmo da revolução comunista que deu origem à União Soviética. Conhecida como "Korobeiniki" ("mascates", em russo), a composição é baseada em um poema de Nikolai Nekrasov publicado em 1861, durante o Império Russo.

Nekrasov era conhecido por retratar a vida do povo russo. Os versos contam a história de um vendedor ambulante que se encontra com uma jovem. Com o passar do tempo, o poema ganhou uma versão musical e se popularizou como canção folclórica russa.

Capa da canção folclórica 'Korobeiniki'. — Foto: Reprodução/Wikimedia Commons

A canção entrou no repertório de grupos musicais do Exército Soviético, conhecidos no Ocidente como "Coro do Exército Vermelho". Um desses conjuntos a gravou ao vivo no Royal Albert Hall, em Londres, em março de 1988. O mesmo disco traz o hino britânico, árias de ópera e até "Yesterday", dos Beatles.

Não se trata, porém, de uma música militar ou revolucionária . Nos anos 1930, um musicólogo soviético chegou a lamentar que "Korobeiniki", cujo herói é um comerciante, fosse mais popular que as canções revolucionárias, segundo o jornal americano "The Boston Globe".

O Tetris foi criado em 1984 por Alexey Pajitnov, pesquisador da Academia de Ciências da União Soviética, em Moscou. A primeira versão do jogo, porém, não tinha som.

"Korobeiniki" virou o tema do Tetris em 1989, quando o compositor japonês Hirokazu Tanaka fez o arranjo para a versão do Game Boy, da Nintendo. Foi essa versão que ganhou o mundo.

Ou seja, a melodia que virou hit da direita brasileira ficou famosa graças a um jogo criado na União Soviética, ainda que no arranjo de um compositor japonês.

Funk do 'petista disfarçado', tocado em comícios da direita, tem base popularizada na União Soviética. — Foto: Reprodução

A melodia desembarcou no funk muito antes da campanha. Uma montagem musical com a melodia do Tetris era popular nos bailes cariocas. No início dos anos 2000, a Furacão 2000 inseriu a melodia "Jonathan da Nova Geração", cantada por Jonathan Costa, filho dos donos da equipe, quando ele tinha 7 anos.

A faixa combinava o tema do Tetris do Game Boy com o Volt Mix, batida criada em 1988 pelo DJ americano Battery Brain e muito usada no funk carioca dos anos 1990. Reaproveitar bases e trechos de músicas conhecidas é uma marca do gênero.

Em 2026, "Solinho do Fora PT" repetiu a combinação, com novos versos dirigidos ao PT e à esquerda.

Como o g1 mostrou, o funk virou trilha das campanhas da direita em 2026. Jingles no ritmo, com apoio a Flávio e críticas ao PT, embalaram atos e vídeos de nomes como Nikolas Ferreira, Lucas Pavanato e Eduarda Campopiano. No domingo do segundo turno, seis das 50 músicas mais ouvidas no país no Spotify eram desse tipo.

O uso foi alvo de críticas por contradição, já que políticos conservadores costumam associar os bailes funk à "narcocultura". Pavanato, que foi relator da CPI dos Pancadões na Câmara Municipal de São Paulo, diz que "o problema com o funk, por óbvio, é a letra, não o ritmo". A estratégia não atraiu grandes nomes do gênero: MCs como Hariel e PH apoiaram Lula, e outros ficaram neutros.

articles.title: Macklemore calls Free Palestine Tour his 'favourite thing' he has ever been part of
articles.summary: Rapper Macklemore shares heartfelt gratitude for the Free Palestine Tour, emphasizing collective voices and advocacy for Palestinian rights in London.
articles.body: Rapper Macklemore has expressed gratitude to the musicians, speakers and audiences who came together for the Free Palestine Tour in London, describing it as his "favourite thing" he has ever been part of.Macklemore, whose real name is Benjamin Hammond Haggerty, took to Instagram and said that the event reaffirmed the power of collective voices and platforms in advocating for Palestinian freedom, dignity and rights."The Free Palestine Tour is my favorite thing I've ever been a part of I am still overwhelmed with gratitude and awe for every musician who stepped on stage in London. Every speaker. Every person who chose to be there," Macklemore wrote in the caption section.He added: "We live in an era where advocating for Palestinian life and freedom is controversial. Where saying that Palestine should be free, that Palestinians deserve the same dignity, safety and rights as everyone else, can come at a cost."The rapper said that the tour served as a reaffirmation that "when we collectively use our voices, our stages and our platforms to stand for the freedom of others, something profound happens. And the crowd is just as much a part of that as the artists. We all are.""When we move beyond the fear of "how will this affect my career?" and center collective liberation, something shifts. Love is found. And that feeling of love was abundant in London. I can still feel it in my body."He further wrote: "After five of the most intense weeks, reaching out to artists, organizing, dealing with logistics and constant meetings, it felt like we could all finally exhale. There is so much work to do. The march is long. But this felt like a beautiful step toward rekindling something in all of our hearts.""Thank you to all the artists and speakers that said yes. And thank you to everyone that bought a ticket and supported. I feel honored to have shared that experience with you all. What a beautiful outcome."Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. Download the TOI app.Give your child the gift of confidence! Claim your exclusive TOI Masterclass spot today!

articles.title: Diwali and the politics of gifting
articles.summary: It is that time of the year again when a subtle realisation occurs that gifting in NCR is no less than any competitive sport.
articles.body: It is that time of the year again when a subtle realisation occurs that gifting in NCR is no less than any competitive sport. Each year, you prepare in advance, armed with lessons from the last festive season, only to realise that there are more waiting for you this season. And no matter how well you think you know your friend circle, there are always surprises. Someone sends a luxury hamper, and suddenly your box of mithai or dry fruits looks inadequate. The bigger question isn’t what to gift, but how to match last year’s generosity without appearing either stingy or extravagant. Plus, there could be added pressure if you are known as someone who always sends a gift of a certain value. You go lower than that, friends and relatives might assume (and gossip) that you are broke. You spend more, and there might be questions raised about ‘where is all this money coming from?’ Clearly, there is no winning this game.A month before the festive season begins, a budget is earmarked for Diwali gifting. There are categories within that budget, as per the hierarchy of gifting – one for neighbours, friends and acquaintances, a slightly more personalised, better gift for close friends, and a premium range for business associates. And for some, there is an added category for those who unexpectedly turn up with a gift close to Diwali. Of course, the hierarchy isn’t always determined by how close you are to someone. There are people you meet once a year but cannot afford to leave out of your gifting list, and then there are friends who would be perfectly happy sharing a box of mithai with you. The tricky part is deciding who belongs where, because getting the category wrong could mean an entire year of awkwardness. And just when you think the lists have been finalised, budgets approved and gifts dispatched, someone who wasn’t even on your list sends you an elaborate hamper. Now, what should have been a pleasant surprise becomes a fresh problem. One option is to pick up something from the stack of gifts kept aside specifically for regifting. But the real dilemma arises when the gift you have received looks rather expensive and you have absolutely no intention of spending a similar amount on a return gesture. Do you send something modest and hope they don’t notice the difference? Do you make anexception and stretch your budget? Or do you simply thank them profusely and hope that gratitude counts as reciprocation?Then comes the rather delicate business of regifting. While most people have no qualms about passing on an unopened box of dry fruits or an elaborate festive hamper, one has to be extremely careful about where it came from and where it is headed. The last thing you want is for a gift to find its way back to the person who originally sent it.There is also the question of whether a gift needs to be personally delivered or whether sending it through a driver is enough. Does dropping it off at the gate count as a festive gesture? Should you call to check if it has been received? And if someone makes the effort to personally deliver a gift, are you now expected to return the favour with a visit? Suddenly, the gifting exercise begins to resemble the scheduling of Diwali parties, with lists, locations and social obligations to manage. Perhaps the most amusing part of this entire exercise is that while everyone insists that ‘it’s the thought that counts’, an extraordinary amount of thought goes into calculating the value of the gift, the relationship with the recipient and the possible consequences of getting either wrong. By the time Diwali arrives, you have spent so much time deciding on gifting that you begin to wonder whether festive gifting was ever meant to be this complicated.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Dwayne Johnson beams with pride as daughter honours Polynesian culture
articles.summary: Dwayne Johnson expresses pride for daughter Jazzy and Nonosina dancers as they celebrate Polynesian culture through dance at the Rose Bowl, performing in front of 33,000 spectators. Actor encourages youth to embrace cultural heritage and continue striving for greatness.
articles.body: Hollywood star Dwayne Johnson expressed pride in his daughter Jazzy and the dancers of Nonosina as they honoured Polynesian culture through their graceful storytelling movements in front of an audience of 33,000.Calling himself a proud father and "Uncle Rock" to the young performers, the actor took to Instagram and encouraged them to remain humble, hungry and keep reaching for more.Johnson wrote: "Very proud of my daughter, Jazzy and all of our @nonosina1965 dancers, upholding and honoring our Polynesian culture with their beautiful, and GRACEFUL storytelling movements at the @rosebowlstadium in front of 33,000 strong."The art is in our dance. The love is in our mana. Clearly I'm a very proud faced papa and "uncle Rock" to all these young ones - keep reaching for more, humble, hungry and every step along the way matters."He concluded: "Shout to @uclaathletics + @uclafootball for all the love - and stay undefeated and shout to the core lady bosses @tiana_nonosina @kay.faam @laurenhashianofficial for making it all happen with love, pride, discipline x Uncle Rock cheehooo."On the acting front, Johnson will next be seen in 'Jumanji: The Open World'. The upcoming installment will bring back Hart as Franklin Finbar, Johnson as Dr. Bravestone, Jack Black as Professor Sheldon Oberon and Karen Gillan as Ruby Roundhouse.Jumanji, first released in 1995, was directed by Joe Johnston and based on Chris Van Allsburg's 1981 children's picture book. The film is the first installment in the Jumanji film series and stars Robin Williams, Kirsten Dunst, David Alan Grier, Bonnie Hunt, Jonathan Hyde, and Bebe Neuwirth.Johnson is a semi-retired professional wrestler. He is signed to WWE, where he performs on a part-time basis. Widely regarded as one of the greatest professional wrestlers of all time, he was integral to the World Wrestling Federation's development and success during the Attitude Era.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more. articles.title: Mahjong finds a seat at the Diwali party table
articles.summary: What once used to be a popular social engagement among Indian army wives in cantonment towns has now made inroads in Delhi’s elite circle as its favourite
articles.body: What once used to be a popular social engagement among Indian army wives in cantonment towns has now made inroads in Delhi’s elite circle as its favourite party game. The popularity of Mahjong, a 19th century Chinese tile game, started making news last year. From then to now it has skyrocketed to an extent that Mahjong has acquired a high table at Diwali parties. The game’s social status and engagement score even seem to exceed the popularity of traditional games like Teen Patti at Diwali parties. Now, a setup or two for Mahjong with highly engrossed players has become a common sight at parties this festive season.‘Now most Diwali parties have a Mahjong setup or two’Fashion designer Ritu Beri, a proud Army kid who’s grown up watching her mother play Mahjong, shares that she is surprised at how the game, which she saw her mom playing all her life, has now become the talk of the town. “In the Army, it was the one game that everyone played, there was no Rummy or anything else, for army wives it was only Mahjong. I still remember my mom had the most beautiful ivory Mahjong set, a rare set. It is so nostalgic for me when someone says, ‘Let’s meet over Mahjong,’” she tells us.The ‘game of luck and strategy’ has been popular at theme parties, and we have been told that there is “hardly any upscale kitty party that doesn’t have Mahjong.” Given its popularity, it is understandable when we are told that Karwa Chauth Mahjong events and parties were a hit this festive season.“I do Mahjong events and parties with my friends regularly and it was one of the most appropriate fit for a Karwa Chauth gathering. This game keeps you engrossed, you actually can spend hours playing it. Once you start playing, it gets so interesting that you lose track of time. Now most Delhi parties have Mahjong setups and it is as popular as card games, even more,” says Sunayana Bhinder Chibba, who has been organising Mahjong parties for her friends.‘Mahjong is replacing games like Rummy and Teen Patti’Along with parties, there are also festive events being organised by Mahjong-exclusive clubs with hundreds of members across cities. The growing interest has also turned Mahjong into a reason to host a party rather than just as an activity. From private sessions among friends to larger gatherings organised by clubs, the game has acquired a social calendar of its own. Mumbai-based Ria Bajaj, co-founder of The Mahjong Network, shares, “Ever since the beginning of the festive season, we have been flooded with queries to arrange Mahjong events and private parties. We have an event or a party happening every two days in the city and requests are still pouring in.”And while Mahjong may have traditionally been associated with women’s social gatherings, its growing popularity is now drawing interest from everyone. So much so that even restaurants are looking to cash in on the trend by adding Mahjong to their festive celebrations. Maneka Jain Daswani, Ria’s partner and co-founder of The Mahjong Network based in Delhi, adds, “This festive season Diwali card parties are being replaced by Mahjong parties as it is no longer a ladies’ game. It will be safe to say that Mahjong is fast replacing party games like Rummy or Teen Patti.”‘People are requesting crash courses for the game’The spike in Mahjong’s popularity has also led to many seeking crash courses for the game, especially in the festive season. Noida-based Mahjong coach from Indian Mahjong Association, Vineeta Sahni, who has been playing Mahjong for over three decades now and is also teaching the game now, says that she has been getting requests every day from people who want to learn Mahjong in a couple of hours. “Some people are only seeing this as a social engagement activity and to be a part of the circle, they are looking for crash courses, but the game is not learnt this way. We conduct sessions to introduce the game, provide tables and even train individuals who are interested in learning the game. We recommend a three-hour class to learn and I think five classes are essential. During the festive season, we are witnessing a demand for trainers by those hosting Mahjong parties,” says Vineeta.Get the latest Bollywood & Entertainment News, and more.
